intended_statement: For every finite alphabet X, including the empty alphabet, and every F2-vector subspace V of all functions X* -> F2 preserved by every letter derivative, the following are equivalent: (i) for every ordinary language T, the residual cosets D_u(1_T)+V, for all words u including epsilon, form a finite set if and only if T is regular in Mathlib's Language.IsRegular sense; (ii) for every f in V, the ordinary language {w | f(w)=1} is regular.
assumptions: X is an arbitrary type with Finite X; no Nonempty X assumption.
F2 is ZMod 2, with its existing Mathlib field and finite-type instances.
V is a Submodule (ZMod 2) (List X -> ZMod 2).
For every letter a and f in V, the function v -> f(a::v) belongs to V. This implies preservation by all word derivatives.
Classical logic and the ordinary Mathlib quotient constructions are used. No normal form, saturation theorem, finite residual bound, or equivalent regularity conclusion is assumed.
scope: Fully proved for the complementary-series finite-coset formulation and ordinary Mathlib language regularity. The correspondence from the original source semifilter axioms and agreement relation to V is written only. Filter classification and the parity normal form are written only. This root is not a full formalization of book Q2 in its original family-of-languages syntax.
novelty_status: No discovery or priority claim. The proof uses classical finite-span and Myhill-Nerode methods. Comparison with unrecovered 2017 and 2024 primary full texts remains outstanding.

intended_statement: For every finite alphabet X and derivative-invariant F2-vector subspace V of all series X* -> F2, define C(V) by finiteness of the actual residual coset set {D_u f+V | u in X*}. Then C(C(V)) = C(V). The invariance needed for the outer C is proved from that of V.
assumptions: X is an arbitrary type with Finite X, including empty and unary alphabets.
V is a Submodule (ZMod 2) (List X -> ZMod 2) preserved by every letter derivative.
C(V) is defined as the inverse image of the finite-orbit submodule of the quotient by V, and its equivalence to actual residual-coset finiteness is proved.
No idempotence, parity normal form, Boolean closure, regular-left product closure, or equivalent full conclusion is an assumption.
scope: Full all-parameter saturation theorem for actual F2-series residual cosets. Its proof constructs finite representative states with epsilon at the initial state, proves that their transition errors have finite orbits in the relevant quotient, and constructs a finite invariant span. Source semifilter translation and parity-expression elimination remain written only.
novelty_status: Not established as new; no prior-art clearance or discovery claim.

intended_statement: For every finite alphabet X and every pair of derivative-invariant F2-vector subspaces V,W of all series X* -> F2, C(V)=C(W) if and only if V is a subset of C(W) and W is a subset of C(V), where C is actual finite residual-coset recognition.
assumptions: X is an arbitrary type with Finite X; the empty alphabet is allowed.
V and W are arbitrary Submodules (ZMod 2) (List X -> ZMod 2), each preserved by every letter derivative.
C is defined using finite word orbits in quotient modules, not using the proposed finite parity normal form.
Monotonicity, extensivity and saturation idempotence are proved dependencies, not hypotheses. No finite-index equality or equivalent full goal is assumed.
scope: Full semantic mutual-inclusion theorem in the complementary-series formulation. The original agreement-congruence correspondence and the non-tautological mutual finite-parity-expression criterion for source families are proved only in candidate-proof.md. This root is not promoted as the complete original-syntax Q3 formalization.
novelty_status: No novelty claim. Special-filter results in Prodinger 1980 and Guo-Wang-Shum 2010 are acknowledged; broader literature comparison is incomplete.
